shared_elements: horizontal band(s) dividing or crossing the surface
low-relief carved detail on a plain ground
justification: Both show a human figure and circular disc motifs set off by horizontal bands, but these are generic devices: A is a single massive frontal anthropomorphic figure whose body is covered with schematic emblems (a chest disc, paired arcs, incised bands), while B is a naturalistic profile procession scene of a humped animal led by a striding attendant beneath a register of repeated rosettes. There is no shared narrative relationship, no shared arrangement (a single frontal icon versus a horizontal narrative register), and the rendering conventions — blocky schematic emblem-carving versus modelled profile figures — are quite different.
